primary_witness.archive: SNLTR Rabindra Rachanabali digital edition (digitization of Swarabitan, Visva-Bharati)

scan_verification.scope: lines 1-2 (sthayi): every matra and lyric syllable
scan_verification.printed_header: none — no raga/taal line is printed for this song
notes: Resolves a conflict with a secondary source. geetabitan.com lists this song as Dadra; the printed page carries no taal line and no vibhag dandas anywhere in the notation, which is how Swarabitan sets a talamukta (free-rhythm) song. The talamukta reading stands.
Three-note matras in the print (গমপা, গমগা) match the corpus's matra-fraction encoding exactly.

provenance.encoding_method: automated parse of the witness's notation grid (tools/parse_nltr.py) + manual review of every line
